detailed_descriptions.en: Turn filthy rugs into satisfying before-and-after transformations while running your own rug-cleaning business. Take on customer jobs, work through every stage of the cleaning process, earn money, upgrade your equipment, and improve your shop as your business grows. SATISFYING CLEANING Every rug starts as a mess. Use different tools and machines to remove dirt step by step and watch each rug slowly return to its former glory. Take your time, enjoy the process, and experience the satisfaction of turning something filthy into something spotless. RUN YOUR OWN RUG-CLEANING BUSINESS Customers bring rugs to your shop looking for help. Accept new jobs, clean their rugs, get paid, and reinvest your earnings into better equipment and improvements for your business. Start small and gradually build a rug-cleaning shop you can be proud of. EVERY JOB IS DIFFERENT Work on a variety of rugs with different patterns, sizes, and levels of dirt. Procedurally generated customers and jobs help keep each workday fresh while always giving you the same satisfying goal: Make the rug clean again. UPGRADE YOUR EQUIPMENT Start with basic cleaning equipment and unlock better tools and machines as you progress. Invest your earnings into upgrades that make your work faster, easier, and more satisfying. MAKE THE SHOP YOURS Your workplace is more than just a place to clean rugs. Use the money you earn to improve and customize your shop and gradually turn a small operation into a successful business. RELAX AND ENJOY THE PROCESS There is no need to rush. Take the next customer job, work through the cleaning process at your own pace, and enjoy the simple satisfaction of watching dirt disappear. Clean rugs. Earn money. Upgrade your equipment. Improve your shop. Take on the next job.
